text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: When a preferred affinity loses: several plugins team up against it

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Affinity alone wins easily, but the node with the cache pod is busier, so the general-purpose plugins all prefer the other node.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: The pod: api, with a PREFERRED pod affinity for the cache pod (same node)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Node 1: emptier · api image cached · no api replica yet

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Node 2: runs the cache pod and one api replica · busier · no image

text.tspan: Choice A: make it a hard rule (filtering)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: required… instead of preferred…: Node 1 has no cache pod,
so it is filtered out before scoring. Node 2 is the only
candidate. Trade-off: if Node 2 is full, the pod waits.

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Choice B: change the weights (your own scheduler)

text.font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: On EKS this needs a second scheduler (schedulerName).
